title: File:Energy infrastructure facility in Kyiv Oblast after Russian drone attack, 2022-10-27 (02).webp
desc: Fire at an energy infrastructure facility in Kyiv region of Ukraine after Russian strike by Iranian Shahed kamikaze drones in the night on 27 October 2022. As a result of the destructions, supply of electricity in Kyiv and central regions was furthermore restricted.
